Name: Mushroom Cursors
Author: WizardsLizards
Description:
The vanilla cursor looks like a mushroom anyways... might as well work out the details.

There might be further versions that add different kinds of mushrooms or expand and change other parts of the cursors too, but what has been uploaded will always be kept, so if you don't like the new updates you will always have the old ones, no matter the version!

There are 2 versions as of now, with the alternative one turning the hand, hourglas and speaking-bubble brown. The vanilla one is the default, the darker one can be enabled via the config file.

I personally like the darker one more as it fits better with DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour (which i love :D)

Always open for suggestions on how to improve! (I have considered adding a darker border to the cursor but didn't feel the need - but that could be an easy addition)
